Admissions & International Office
Dublin City University (DCU)
Dublin, Ireland
letter.subject: Application for an Erasmus+ exchange semester (S9, Fall 2027)
paragraphs: I am a second-year engineering student in Digital Science at ENSEEIHT (Toulouse INP), currently following my degree as an apprentice developer at AG-CARTO. I am writing to apply for an Erasmus+ exchange semester at Dublin City University during my ninth semester, in the fall of 2027. Dublin is my first choice, and I would be very proud to represent my school there.

Over the past three years, my apprenticeship has taught me to build React widgets for real users and to take part in the infrastructure and DevOps side of a company's products. Before ENSEEIHT, I earned a French bachelor's degree in Computer Science at the Institute of Technology of Bayonne, where I led a team during a regional data visualisation challenge and took part in the 'Nuit de l'Info' hackathon twice. These experiences gave me solid technical foundations, but also a real taste for teamwork, project management and building things people actually use.

Studying in Ireland would allow me to work in a fully English-speaking academic environment, which is essential for the international career I am aiming for. I am eager to deepen my knowledge in software engineering and cloud technologies, and to experience a teaching approach that is more project-based and open to industry. Dublin's dynamic tech ecosystem, home to many international software companies, makes it an ideal place to learn how these subjects are practised beyond France.

Beyond academics, I am curious about Irish culture and its strong storytelling tradition, which echoes my personal passions for writing and drawing. I am also used to joining and organising communities, such as the tabletop role-playing group I help run, and I would be glad to get involved in student life on campus.
Thank you for considering my application. I would be delighted to discuss my motivation further and remain at your disposal for any additional information.

Aalto University is known for bringing together technology, art and design, and this is exactly what attracts me. Outside of my studies, I write fantasy stories and design characters through digital art. I believe Aalto's multidisciplinary environment would let me connect these creative interests with my engineering skills, and I would bring curiosity, persistence and a strong team spirit to the projects I join.
Thank you for your consideration. I remain at your disposal for any further information.
